records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Ventures
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 2 [calendar:87a1c813 call held, email:fe430e6e], showing real intent, but no invite and no key milestone 6 days in, no customer replies to two outreach emails [email:dbef5902], and 0 tickets suggest low engagement. Pro plan is a positive signal; 8 days remain.

draft.subject: Following up from our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Good speaking last week. I saw you've got your first project set up in Wrenfield — nice start. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the fastest way to see whether it fits how Lantern Ventures works.

The other step worth doing early is bringing in a teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through either one on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
